description_en: Corrects images vertically in a specified sub-scene and removes the sub-scene association after the correction
description_zh: 对指定子场景下的图片进行垂直矫正，矫正后会删除该子场景关联关系
name: RectVertical

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable door prediction
parameters.name: detect_door

parameters.help_en: The number of doors to predict. This parameter takes effect only when DetectDoor is set to true
parameters.help_zh: 需要预测的门的数量,DetectDoor为true时生效
parameters.name: count_detect_door

schema.description_en: The API response information, including the request ID, call success status, and other result fields
schema.description_zh: 接口返回信息，包含请求 ID、调用是否成功以及其他结果字段

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The authentication diagnostics details returned when a permission check fails. The details include the principal, action, policy, and denial cause
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 权限校验失败时返回的鉴权诊断详情，包含鉴权主体、操作、策略和拒绝原因

AuthAction.description_en: The authentication action that triggered the permission denied error, which can be used to troubleshoot the issue or grant the required permissions
AuthAction.description_zh: 触发无权限错误的鉴权操作，可用于排查或授予所需权限

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The identity identifier of the authentication principal. The display format varies for RAM users, RAM roles, and SSO federated identities
AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_zh: 鉴权主体的身份标识；RAM 用户、RAM 角色和 SSO 联合身份的展示形式不同

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the authentication principal belongs
AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_zh: 鉴权主体所属阿里云账号的 UID

AuthPrincipalType.description_en: The identity type of the authentication principal, such as RAM user, RAM role, or SSO federated identity
AuthPrincipalType.description_zh: 鉴权主体的身份类型，例如 RAM 用户、RAM 角色或 SSO 联合身份

EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_en: The encoded diagnostic message for the permission denied error. An authorized account administrator can decode this message to troubleshoot the denial cause
EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_zh: 无权限错误的编码诊断信息，可交由具备权限的账号管理员解码以排查拒绝原因

NoPermissionType.description_en: The type of the no-permission cause, which indicates whether the access is implicitly or explicitly denied
NoPermissionType.description_zh: 无权限原因类型，区分未被显式授权和被显式拒绝

PolicyType.description_en: The type of the policy that caused the permission denied error, such as a control policy, session policy, or identity-based policy
PolicyType.description_zh: 导致无权限的策略类型，例如管控策略、会话策略或基于身份的策略

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
